title: Hydraulically feasible regeneration-reserve-aware hydrogen pressure swing adsorption under uncertainty with staged membrane polishing and a quantum-ready probability event
description: Reproducibility package for a pressure-consistent dynamic hydrogen PSA, staged polymer and palladium polishing, public-data validation, uncertainty analysis, two post-freeze public experimental hold-outs, a verified 66-logical-qubit portable OpenQASM oracle, and an exact two-bit final-event truth-mapping probe executed over all 64 inputs on IBM Kingston.
notes: The v0.2.3 update adds Chen et al. 2023 and Voigt 2022 experimental tables without refitting. All 12 Chen endpoint-direction tests pass; 6/13 Voigt cycles pass the source Type-1-plus-70%-recovery event, with at least one pass in each feed stage. The IBM result remains a basis-state truth-mapping test, not coherent QAE or quantum advantage.
